days.title: History and Nature Exploration
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Schrieversheide
stops.detail: The Schrieversheide, which is described as valuable and beautiful, is one of the hillier heaths in the Netherlands and the only notable heath in South Limburg.

stops.name: Observatorium
stops.detail: There is also an observatory, and the Landgraaf Brunssummerheide, a defensive fortification more than a kilometer long, is also located in the area.
